notes.title: update v1.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Obligatory migrations + gameplay polishing.[/b]

Packaging and statistics migrated to another stack.
Mac build includes X64 and M1(not tested after packaging).
The 2D variant keeps the old codebase(not developed anymore).
Android R.I.P.

Aggressive blocking now depends on blocking variant.
In case of hands directed to both sides aggressive blocking prohibited.

When you buy, consider this as support.
If you want just to play, try demo or web version. They are similar.

notes.title: Update to 3D version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Added 3D playable area, ball, characters(planned to switch background to full 3D stuff in future)
Attack dX(horizontal screen direction) target of 3D game mode, determined using touch/click coordinates.
Polished code to improve gameplay:
[list]
[*] - improved toss direction(decreased distance from net)
[*] - added AI fast settings buttons
[*] - prevented some unnatural ball bouncing, and restyled for better result
[*] - fixed some lags, which was hidden using increased distance of ball toss from net
[*] - refreshed demo version, to latest code stuff
[*] - blocking out of 3D mode now possible not only to left and right directions, but front/back too
[*] - restyled prime defense positions schemes which allow use serve, to win extra points, depend of enemy tonus
[*] - added menu to choose 3D or 2.5D game mode
[/list]

notes.title: 3D implementation in development
notes.content: characters and environment planned to be replaced by 3D implementation using GLTF format, and 2D version still planned to be available, using dialog before language dialog
